title: Lemon Garlic Herb Marinade
steps: Whisk everything together in a bowl.
Add the chicken, turn to coat, cover or seal in a zip-top bag and refrigerate for 30 minutes to 4 hours. Longer and the lemon makes the surface mushy.
Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Set a wire rack on a foil-lined sheet pan.

Wipe off the excess marinade so the chicken browns, place it on the rack, and bake: bone-in thighs or drumsticks 35–45 min, boneless breast 18–24 min. No basting needed. Done at 165°F (74°C) for breast, 175°F (79°C) or more for thighs and drumsticks. Rest 5 minutes.
Sear in a hot pan or grill over medium-high heat.
Never reuse marinade that has touched raw chicken. For basting or sauce, set some aside before adding the chicken.
